scope: Offline validity evidence on the existing five clips; no pose inference or warning decisions

parameters.numerical_feature_eligibility: Existing measurement numerically_usable flag and finite saved current position; seed rows kept without fabricated FB or motion
parameters.rank_percentile: (count strictly smaller + half count tied) / valid count
parameters.rank_groups: min(floor(4 * percentile), 3); per-frame and per-clip; ties stay together
parameters.quartile_interpretation: Descriptive relative strata, not numeric warning cutoffs or accepted quality gates

evaluation.proxy: Convex hull of LEFT_SHOULDER, RIGHT_SHOULDER, LEFT_HIP, RIGHT_HIP; all four must be human-visible with coordinates and form a nondegenerate hull
evaluation.inside_definition: Signed point-to-polygon distance >= 0; exact boundary included; no tuned dilation or distance cutoff
evaluation.missing_reference_policy: No three-point hull, coordinate fill, raw substitute or interpolation; explicit null and unchanged full frame denominator
evaluation.paired_missing_policy: Either endpoint proxy absent means unavailable; exclude only from conditional statistic and explicitly report the original denominator
outputs: signed distances and current/pair proxy coverage
quality-rank group support with frame counts
conditional quality-score rank AUC for outside-torso-proxy
five uniform-frame contact sheets and reference-clip comparison
evaluation.auc_direction: Larger quality score ranks outside proxy higher; no direction fitting
evaluation.auc_limit: Feature-frame rows are correlated; descriptive known-development evidence, not independent samples, warning recall, classification accuracy or identity proof
evaluation.canonical_gt_usage: Evaluator-only context for known major failures, never a producer input or new warning target label
evaluation.visual_inspection: Agent diagnostic notes remain separate from human GT
evaluation.other_clips: No reviewed torso coordinates; manual proxy unavailable, not successful validation
